error.forbidden: Your role may not do this.
error.conflict: This clashes with an earlier change. Reload the page and try again.
error.insufficient_funds: The wallet balance is too low for this.
error.invalid: Some of what you entered is not accepted.
error.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute.
error.state: This cannot be done right now.

overview.title: Overview
overview.desc: Users, services, revenue and health at a glance.

users.title: Users
users.desc: Find customers, see their services, orders and wallet, ban or unban, adjust balances.

services.title: Services
services.desc: Every subscription with its usage; extend, reset traffic, disable, delete or resync from 3x-ui.

support.title: Support
support.desc: Ticket inbox: reply to customers in the bot, assign tickets, canned replies.

broadcasts.title: Broadcasts
broadcasts.desc: Send a message to all or some customers, now or later, and follow its progress.

plans.title: Plans
plans.desc: Create and edit plans, traffic packages and the free trial; prices and order.

payments.title: Orders & payments
payments.desc: Orders, payments and the review queue with receipt screenshots; retry provisioning, refunds.

ledger.title: Wallet & ledger
ledger.desc: Every wallet movement, with filters and CSV export.

reports.title: Reports
reports.desc: Sales per day, week or month and per currency, the top plans, how orders were paid, and CSV export.

discounts.title: Discounts & referrals
discounts.desc: Discount codes and their use, the referral reward and top inviters.

resellers.title: Resellers
resellers.desc: Reseller tiers and prices, credit limits, their customers and settlements.

branding.title: Branding & texts
branding.desc: Store name, logo, colors and every bot text in Persian and English.

settings.title: Settings
settings.desc: Maintenance mode, required channel, notifications, limits, support and time zone.

servers.title: 3x-ui servers
servers.desc: Your panels, their health and inbounds, and which plans use which server.

gateways.title: Payment gateways
gateways.desc: Turn payment methods on or off with their details, keep Zarinpal's keys encrypted, test it and see its payments.

staff.title: Staff
staff.desc: Who may use the dashboard, their roles, logins and sessions.

system.title: System
system.desc: Health and version of every service, updates, backups and the license.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.desc: Every change made by staff, searchable and exportable.

placeholder.coming: This section is built in milestone {n} of Phase 4.
placeholder.today: Until then, the bot's /admin panel does this.

login.title: Log in
login.subtitle: Staff dashboard of {brand}
login.link_hint: In the Telegram bot, send /dashboard (or tap Dashboard in /admin). You get a link that logs you in once, within 2 minutes.
login.link_invalid: This login link was used already or has expired. Ask the bot for a new one.
login.locked: Too many failed logins. Wait 15 minutes, or use a link from the bot.
login.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute.
login.not_configured: Password logins are off on this install. Use a link from the bot.
login.no_password_yet: A password login is added from My account after logging in with the bot.

overview.failed_hint: Paid orders the panel did not create yet

order.title: Order
order.payments_unavailable: The payments service did not answer; payment attempts are not shown.
order.refund_intro: {amount} goes to the customer's wallet and the order is cancelled (it was not delivered). The customer is told.
order.refund_intro_delivered: {amount} goes to the customer's wallet. The service was delivered and keeps working: delete it on its page if needed. The customer is told.

account.title: My account
account.password_on: On, username {username}. Every login also needs a code from your authenticator app.
account.password_off: Off. You log in with links from the bot.
account.password_intro: A password is a second way in, e.g. when Telegram is unavailable. It always needs a code from an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy, Microsoft Authenticator…).
account.password_unavailable: Password logins are off on this install (no master key).
account.scan: Scan this code with your authenticator app, or type the key by hand:
account.confirm_code: Then enter the 6-digit code it shows:
account.enabled: Password login is on. Your other sessions were logged out.
account.remove_confirm: Turn off password login? You will then log in only with links from the bot.
account.code_wrong: That code is not right. Check the time on your phone and try the next code.
account.username_taken: Another staff member uses this username.
account.change_intro: Choose the new username and password, then scan the new code with your authenticator app.
account.code_hint: The 6-digit code your authenticator app shows now.
account.code_required: For your safety, enter the current code from your authenticator app.
account.sessions_intro: Devices logged in to the dashboard with your account. Log out any you do not recognise.
account.revoke_others_confirm: Log out every device except this one?

common.reason_hint: Kept in the audit log with your name.

user.title: Customer
user.adjust_intro: Add money to the wallet or take some out. The customer is told when money is added.
user.ban_intro: A banned customer cannot buy or renew. Their running services keep working until they end (turn them off on their pages if needed).
user.unban_intro: The customer can buy and renew again.

service.title: Service
service.search: Service id, Telegram id, {'@'}username or panel email
service.days_ago: ended {n} day ago | ended {n} days ago
service.extend_intro: Add days, traffic or both. It is applied like a renewal (free), and the customer is told.
service.reset_intro: Sets the used traffic back to zero on the panel (a service that had used it all works again).
service.disable_intro: The customer can no longer connect. Renewals and reminders stop until you turn it on again.
service.enable_intro: The customer can connect again; its end date and traffic still apply.
service.delete_intro: Removes the account from the 3x-ui panel for good: the link stops working. The service and its orders stay in the records.
service.done_extend: Extension added: it is applied in a few seconds

plan.intro: Plans are what customers buy in the bot. Traffic packages add traffic to a running service; the free trial is a plan marked as a trial.
plan.name: Plan
plan.trial_hint: Free trial (each customer can take it once)
plan.topup_hint: Traffic package (adds traffic to a running service)
plan.servers_help: New services of this plan are created only on these servers. Empty means any server. Renewals and traffic packages stay on the service's own server.
plan.servers_none_usable: None of these servers takes new services now, so orders for this plan would wait. Choose a server that is on.
plan.servers_error: The server list could not be loaded:

payment.queue_empty: Nothing to review. Card, crypto and Zarinpal-link payments appear here when customers send their receipts.
payment.duplicate_hint: Another receipt has the same reference number. Check the photo carefully: it may be a reused receipt.
payment.approve_intro: Approve this payment of {amount}? The order is paid and delivered at once (or the wallet is topped up).
payment.reject_intro: The customer sees your reason in the bot.

ledger.hint: Every movement of every wallet; money taken out is negative.

reports.hint: Sales read from the ledger and the orders, in the store's time zone. Every currency is counted on its own: amounts in different currencies are never added together.
reports.calendar_note: Weeks start on Monday and months are calendar months (Gregorian), in both languages.

customers.title: Customers
customers.new_hint: People whose first paid order was in this period.

chart.partial: The range cuts the lighter bars: they hold only part of their period.

plans.title: Top plans
plans.none: No plan sold in this period.

methods.title: Paid with
methods.none: No paid orders in this period.
methods.hint: A top-up is not a sale: an order paid from the wallet is listed under Wallet balance, whenever the money was topped up.

method_hint.wallet: Paid from the customer's wallet, whatever put the money there: a top-up, a refund, a reward, a change by staff, a reseller's commission or a reseller's credit.
method_hint.manual: Card to card, crypto or a Zarinpal link, approved by staff.
method_hint.gateway: Zarinpal, Telegram Stars or automatic USDT.
method_hint.unknown: A sale with no record of how it was paid.

discount.code_hint: 3-32 letters, digits, _ or -; customers type it in the bot.
discount.once_per_customer: Each customer can use a code once.
discount.referrals_intro: Customers share an invite link from the bot. When someone they invited makes a first purchase, they get this share of it in their wallet. 0 turns invitations off.

branding.intro: Your store's name, look and links. Saved changes reach the bot within a few seconds.
branding.name: Store name
branding.name_hint: Shown in the dashboard header, on the login page, in the browser tab and in bot texts that mention the store. Empty: “{fallback}” here and the bot's Telegram name in the bot.
branding.support_hint: For example {'@'}support. The bot shows it on its support screen and for payment questions (/paysupport).
branding.color_hint: Buttons, links and highlights in the dashboard. Telegram allows only its own button colours, so the bot colours its buttons by meaning instead (green, blue, red). Empty: teal.
branding.color_bad: Write the colour as #rrggbb, for example #0f766e.
branding.color_contrast: White text on this colour is hard to read (contrast {ratio}:1; at least 4.5:1 is recommended). A darker shade reads better.
branding.color_preview: Preview: the dashboard shows this colour until you save it or leave this page.
branding.logo_hint: Shown in the dashboard header, on the login page and as the browser tab icon. PNG, JPEG or WebP up to 512 KB; a square image looks best.
branding.logo_none: No logo yet: the BOBRES icon is shown.
branding.logo_remove_confirm: Remove the logo? The BOBRES icon is shown again.
branding.logo_too_large: This image is larger than 512 KB.
branding.logo_bad_type: Only PNG, JPEG or WebP images are accepted.
branding.logo_bad_size: Each side of the image must be between 16 and 2048 pixels.
branding.logo_unreadable: This file could not be read as an image.
branding.bot_photo_hint: Square PNG or JPEG, at least 160×160; 640×640 looks best. While “Keep the bot’s Telegram profile up to date” is on (Settings → General), the bot sets it as its Telegram profile photo, and removing it makes the bot take off the photo it set, but only while that is still its current photo. While that setting is off, nothing changes in Telegram.
branding.bot_photo_none: No bot photo yet. Until you upload one, the bot changes nothing and the photo set in {'@'}BotFather stays.
branding.bot_photo_remove_confirm: Remove the bot photo? The bot takes the photo it set off its Telegram profile, but only while that is still its current photo: a photo you set later in {'@'}BotFather stays. While “Keep the bot’s Telegram profile up to date” is off, nothing changes in Telegram.
branding.bot_photo_too_large: This image is larger than 512 KB.
branding.bot_photo_bad_type: Only PNG or JPEG images are accepted.
branding.bot_photo_webp: A WebP image cannot be used for the bot photo: save it as PNG or JPEG.
branding.bot_photo_bad_size: Each side of the image must be between 160 and 2048 pixels.
branding.bot_photo_unreadable: This file could not be read as an image.
branding.bot_photo_padded: Not square: it is centred on a white square.
branding.legal_hint: When set, the bot shows Terms and Privacy buttons on its support screen and answers /terms.
branding.url_bad: Enter a full link that starts with https://
branding.currency_hint: How Toman amounts are written in the bot and the dashboard, for example “T”. Empty: the default name.

texts.intro: Every message and button of the bot, in Persian and English. Each text is checked before it is saved, so a mistake cannot break the bot; saved texts reach the bot within a few seconds.
texts.export_hint: Downloads the texts you changed as a JSON file.
texts.import_lang_fixed: The file says which language it is.
texts.import_intro: Every text is checked first: if any has a problem, nothing changes.
texts.import_not_json: This file is not valid JSON.
texts.import_shape: The file must be a JSON object of keys and texts, like the files this page exports.
texts.import_too_large: The file is larger than 1 MB.
texts.import_problems: Nothing was imported. These texts have problems:

texts.html_hint: Telegram formatting works here: {tags}. Write the characters {chars} as {entities}.
texts.plain_hint: Plain text only: no tags and none of the characters {chars}.
texts.empty_hint: An empty text cannot be saved; use the default text instead.
texts.reset_confirm: Put the {lang} text of {key} back to the default?
texts.discard_message: Your edits to this text are not saved yet.

context.caption: Photo caption
context.internal: Internal note, customers do not see it
context.command: Command in the bot’s menu, one line
context.bot_description: Text of an empty chat with the bot
context.bot_about: Short description on the bot’s profile, one line
context.placeholder: Hint in the message box while the bottom menu is shown, one line

problem.placeholder_unknown: {arg} is not one of the values for this text, so it would show as typed.

problem.markup_not_allowed: This place shows plain text: {arg} is not allowed.
problem.too_long: Too long: at most {arg} character. | Too long: at most {arg} characters.
problem.lang_unused: This text is not used in this language.

texts.owner_only: Only the store owner can change the payment texts (where customers are told to send money).

settings.intro: Each card saves on its own. Changes reach the bot within a few seconds.
settings.maintenance_on: Maintenance mode is on: customers only see the maintenance message in the bot. Staff can still use it.
settings.empty: There are no settings to show.
settings.saved_detail: The bot picks up the change within a few seconds.
settings.fix_errors: Fix the marked fields and save again.
settings.locked: Your role may not change these settings.
settings.locked_payments: Only the store owner can change payment details.

maintenance_confirm.title: Turn on maintenance mode?
maintenance_confirm.message: From now on customers only see the maintenance message in the bot: they cannot buy or open their services there. Active services keep working, staff can still use the bot, and payments already under way can finish.

check.ok: Found “{title}”, and the bot is an admin there.
check.ok_not_admin: Found “{title}”, but the bot is not an admin there. Make the bot an admin of the channel and check again.
check.unreachable: The bot cannot be reached right now. Try again in a moment.

problem.not_found: Telegram cannot find this channel. Check the name; for a private channel use its numeric id and make sure the bot is an admin.
problem.not_admin: The bot is not an admin of this channel. Add it as an admin in the channel settings and check again.
problem.not_channel: This is not a channel (it may be a group or a user).
problem.error: Telegram returned an error. Check the name or id and try again.

invalid.channel: A channel {'@'}username (5 to 32 English letters, digits or _, starting with a letter) or a numeric id starting with -100.
invalid.tme_link: A link that starts with https://t.me/
invalid.link_required: A private channel (numeric id) needs an invite link.
invalid.https: A full address that starts with https://
invalid.trc20: A TRC20 address starts with T and has 34 characters.
invalid.erc20: An ERC20 address is 0x followed by 40 characters (0-9, a-f).
invalid.card: A 16-digit card number, or a sheba: IR and 24 digits.
invalid.too_long: At most {max} character. | At most {max} characters.
invalid.one_line: One line only, without control characters.
invalid.timezone: This time zone is not recognised.

general.title: General
general.desc: The time zone the bot shows dates in, and the bot’s own Telegram profile.

maintenance.title: Maintenance mode
maintenance.desc: Close the bot to customers for a while, for example while you move servers.

join.title: Required channel
join.desc: Customers must join your channel before they can use the bot.
join.note: The bot must be an administrator of the channel to check who joined. For a private channel, enter its numeric id (starting with -100) and put an invite link in “Join link”.

notify.title: Staff notifications
notify.desc: Which events the bot reports in Telegram, and to whom.
notify.note: The “payment taken but not recorded” alert is always sent; it cannot be turned off.

limits.title: Limits
limits.desc: Keep floods of messages and tickets in check.

payments.title: Payment details
payments.desc: What the bot shows customers for card transfer, USDT, Telegram Stars and your Zarinpal link.

timezone.label: Time zone
timezone.help: The bot shows dates (such as when a service ends) in this time zone. “Server default” is BOBRES_TIMEZONE, else Tehran. Dates in this dashboard follow your own device’s clock.

bot_profile.label: Keep the bot’s Telegram profile up to date
bot_profile.help: The bot sets its menu commands, its description (the text of an empty chat) and its short description (its profile page), in Persian and English, from its texts: edit them under Branding & texts → Bot texts → Bot profile. It also sets its profile photo from Branding & texts → Store → Telegram bot. Turned off, it takes back its Persian and English texts and the staff menus, so what you set in {'@'}BotFather shows; the photo stays. The bot’s name is always set in {'@'}BotFather.

enabled.label: Maintenance mode
enabled.help: While on, customers only see the maintenance message. Staff can still use the bot and payments in progress finish. Change the message under Branding & texts.

channel.label: Channel
channel.help: A public channel’s {'@'}name, or a private channel’s numeric id. Empty turns the requirement off. Staff are never checked, and customers are let in if Telegram does not answer.

link.label: Join link
link.help: The bot’s “Join” button opens this link. A public channel can leave it empty; a private channel needs an invite link.

new_payment.label: New payment to review
new_payment.help: When a customer sends a card receipt, a USDT transaction or a Zarinpal reference, with a button to review it.

new_ticket.label: New support ticket
new_ticket.help: When a customer writes to support in the bot.

provision_failed.label: Service could not be created
provision_failed.help: When a paid service could not be created on the 3x-ui panel and needs a look.

system_alerts.label: System problems
system_alerts.help: When a service, a 3x-ui server, Zarinpal, the backups, the disk, paid orders, the bot's messages or the license has a problem, once a day while it lasts, and when it is fixed. Open problems always show on the System page.

sales.label: Every sale
sales.help: A message for every paid order, with the customer, plan and amount.

recipients.label: Recipients
recipients.help: “Only the store owner” is the Telegram account set as owner when BOBRES was installed. “Every owner and admin” is every active owner and admin; support staff get only the ticket alerts, never payment or sales ones.

bot_per_10s.label: Messages per user in 10 seconds
bot_per_10s.help: Someone who sends more messages or taps more buttons than this gets no answer until those 10 seconds are over. Stops spam and load on the server.

tickets_per_day.label: Tickets per customer per day
tickets_per_day.help: A customer cannot send more support tickets than this in 24 hours. 0 means no limit.

broadcast_per_sec.label: Broadcast messages per second
broadcast_per_sec.help: How fast broadcasts go out (1 to 25). Telegram allows about 30 messages a second for the whole bot; the bot's replies to customers go first and slow a broadcast down when it is busy.

card_number.label: Card number or sheba
card_number.help: Shown to customers for card-to-card payments: a 16-digit card number, or a sheba (IR and 24 digits). Empty turns card payments off.

card_holder.label: Card holder
card_holder.help: Shown next to the card number so customers know they pay the right person.

usdt_trc20.label: USDT address (TRC20)
usdt_trc20.help: Your Tron wallet address for USDT payments; it starts with T. Empty means this network is not offered.

usdt_erc20.label: USDT address (ERC20)
usdt_erc20.help: Your Ethereum wallet address for USDT payments; it starts with 0x. Empty means this network is not offered.

usdt_rate.label: Toman per USDT
usdt_rate.help: At this rate, Toman-priced plans can also be paid in USDT. Empty means USDT only for plans priced in USDT.

stars_rate.label: Toman per Telegram Star
stars_rate.help: For payments in Telegram Stars; amounts are rounded up to whole Stars. Empty means Stars are not offered.

zarinpal_link.label: Zarinpal link
zarinpal_link.help: Your own Zarinpal payment link (https). Customers pay there and send the reference for you to review.

enabled.label: Offer card to card
enabled.help: When off, customers do not see card to card, even with a card number set.

enabled.label: Offer USDT
enabled.help: When off, customers do not see USDT, even with an address set.

enabled.label: Offer the Zarinpal link
enabled.help: When off, customers do not see the link, even when it is set.

enabled.label: Offer Telegram Stars
enabled.help: When off, customers do not see Stars, even with a rate set.

autoclose_days.label: Close answered tickets after (days)
autoclose_days.help: A ticket whose customer has not written back this many days after a staff reply is closed, without a message. 0 turns this off.

staff.intro: People who can use this dashboard. Every change logs that person out and is kept in the audit log with your reason.
staff.no_owner: No store owner is set in the server settings, so any owner can give or take the owner role. Set one with the bobres menu on the server.
staff.owner_note: Set in the server settings (bobres menu); it cannot be changed here.
staff.role_intro: {name} is logged out everywhere and logs in again with a new link from the bot.
staff.same_role: This is their current role. Choose another one.

role_desc.support: Sees customers, services and payments, extends services and answers tickets.
role_desc.admin: Everything except staff, license, payment gateways and payment details.
role_desc.owner: Everything, including staff and payment details.

staff.revoke_all_intro: Every session of {name} ends. They log in again with a new link from the bot or with their password.
staff.reset_intro: The password and authenticator of {name} are deleted and they are logged out. They log in again with a new link from the bot (/dashboard) and can set a new password in My account.
staff.reset_done: Password reset. They need a new login link from the bot.
staff.unlocked: Unlocked. They can log in with their password again.
staff.remove_intro: {name} becomes a regular customer: dashboard access, password and sessions are removed. Their customer account, services and wallet stay.
staff.add_intro: Find the person among the bot's customers: they must have opened the bot at least once. Once added, they get their dashboard link with /dashboard in the bot.
staff.search_empty: Type a Telegram id or username to search.
staff.search_none: No one found. Only active customers who have opened the bot can be added.
staff.added_hint: They get their dashboard link with /dashboard in the bot.

audit.hint: Every change made by staff, the bot and the system, newest first. Entries cannot be edited or deleted.

support.search_hint: Search by ticket number (#1024), {'@'}username, Telegram id or words from the messages.
support.none_waiting: No ticket is waiting for an answer.
support.subject: Subject

close_reason.auto: Closed automatically: no answer from the customer
close_reason.merged: Merged into the customer's newer ticket

support.blocked_hint: The customer blocked the bot, so replies do not reach them. They get new replies only after they start the bot again.
support.reply_hint: The bot sends replies in the store's name, never yours. Only staff see internal notes. Ctrl+Enter sends.
support.discard_message: Your reply has not been sent and will be lost.
support.close_intro: The customer is told the ticket was closed. If they write again, a new ticket starts.
support.closed_hint: This ticket is closed. Reopen it to reply.
support.draft_kept: Your unsent reply is kept. Reopen the ticket to send it.

canned.hint: Ready texts staff insert into a reply: the text in the customer's language, or the other one when it is empty.
canned.title_hint: Only staff see it, in the list under the reply box.
canned.langs_hint: Write at least one language. Plain text only, up to 3,500 characters each.
canned.delete_confirm: Delete the saved reply {title}? Replies already sent stay as they are.

segment_desc.active: Customers with at least one active service.
segment_desc.expired: Customers who bought before but have no active service now.
segment_desc.never_bought: People who started the bot but have not bought anything yet.

list.empty: You have not sent a broadcast yet. One message can reach all your customers, or a group of them, in the bot.

audience.title: Recipients
audience.left_out: Banned customers and people who blocked the bot do not get it.

text.title: Message
text.label: {lang} text
text.both_hint: Each customer gets the message in the language they chose in the bot, so write it in both languages.
text.one_hint: Only customers whose bot language is {lang} get this message.
text.empty: Write the message in this language.

button.title: Link button
button.add: Add a link button under the message
button.url_bad: Enter a full link that starts with https://
button.label: Button text ({lang})
button.label_chars: The characters {chars} are not allowed in a button.
button.label_long: At most {n} character. | At most {n} characters.

test.hint: Send to me sends the {lang} text to your own Telegram, so you can see it before everyone does.
test.ok: Test message sent to your Telegram.
test.blocked: It did not reach you. Start the bot from your own Telegram account first (/start), then try again.
test.bad_request: Telegram did not accept this message.
test.error: The bot could not send it.
test.unreachable: The bot cannot be reached right now. Try again in a minute.
test.rate_limited: At most 5 test messages a minute. Wait a moment.
test.invalid: The test was not sent. Fix the marked fields first.
test.failed: The test message was not sent.
test.need_text: Write the text in this language first.

save.stale: This broadcast was changed somewhere else (or started sending) after you opened it. Reload to see the latest version; your edits on this page are not saved.
save.wait_check: Wait a moment while the text is checked.

compose.scheduled_note: This broadcast is scheduled for {time}. Save changes keeps that time; to change it, use Schedule.

send.picker_note: Times are in this device's time zone ({zone}).
send.invalid: Enter a complete date and time.
send.past: Pick a time in the future.
send.confirm_now: This message goes to {n} customer now. Messages already sent cannot be taken back. | This message goes to {n} customers now. Messages already sent cannot be taken back.
send.confirm_later: This message goes to {n} customer on {time}. Until then you can still edit or cancel it. | This message goes to {n} customers on {time}. Until then you can still edit or cancel it.
send.count_note: The recipients are counted again when sending starts.
send.zero: No customer matches this choice, so there is nothing to send.
send.stale: This broadcast was changed somewhere else after you opened it, so it was not sent. Check its latest version, then send again if you still want to.

leave.title: Leave without saving?
leave.message: Your changes to this broadcast are not saved yet.

detail.title: Broadcast
detail.done_of: {done} of {total} recipient done | {done} of {total} recipients done
detail.rate_value: {n} message a second | {n} messages a second
detail.halted: The bot paused this broadcast. Fix the cause, then press Resume. The bot said:
detail.unknown_hint: Unknown means the bot could not tell whether Telegram delivered the message; these are never sent again.

action.cancel_message: Customers who have not got it yet will not get it. Messages already sent stay.

hint.failed: Telegram did not accept the message for these customers. Its answer says why.
hint.blocked: These customers blocked the bot. Until they start it again, they do not get later broadcasts either.
hint.unknown: It is not known whether the message reached these customers (for example, the connection to Telegram dropped). It is not sent again, so nobody gets it twice.

reseller.title: Reseller
reseller.none: No resellers yet. Make one from a customer's page, or with Add reseller.
reseller.limit_hint: How far below zero their wallet may go when they buy. 0 or empty: no credit.
reseller.limit_at_least: They owe {amount}: the limit cannot be lower.
reseller.customers_hint: Customers who joined through this reseller's link. Each of their purchases earns the reseller a commission.
reseller.customers_none: Nobody joined through this reseller's link yet.
reseller.statement_hint: Every movement of the reseller's wallet: purchases on credit, commissions and payments.
reseller.not_reseller: This person is not a reseller (any more).
reseller.make_intro: The customer buys at the tier's prices in the bot, may spend on credit up to the limit, and earns a commission on customers who join through their link. They manage everything in the bot.
reseller.make_intro_for: {who} will buy at the tier's prices in the bot, may spend on credit up to the limit, and earns a commission on customers who join through their link. They manage everything in the bot.
reseller.no_tiers: There is no tier yet: create one first.
reseller.made: Done: they are a reseller now
reseller.payment_intro: Money the reseller paid you outside the bot (cash, a card transfer). It goes to their wallet, lowers what they owe, and they are told in the bot.
reseller.terms_intro: Tier, credit limit, commission and note. New prices apply to their next purchase.
reseller.terms_stale: These terms changed after you opened them. Close this window and open it again to see the new values.
reseller.remove_intro: They become a regular customer again: store prices, no credit and no commission. Their services and the customers they brought stay as they are.
reseller.remove_blocked: A reseller who owes money cannot be removed: record their payment first.

tier.intro: A tier sets what its resellers pay: a percentage off store prices, or a fixed price for a plan. The commission is the share of each purchase by a customer who joined through a reseller's link.
tier.none: No tiers yet. Create one before making resellers.
tier.name: Name
tier.commission_hint: Of each purchase by their customers, 0 to {max}.
tier.prices_hint: A fixed price, in the plan's currency, replaces the discount for that plan. Leave it empty to use the discount.
tier.stale: This tier changed after you opened it. Close this window and open it again to see the new values.
tier.in_use: Resellers are on this tier: move them to another tier first.

secret.keep_hint: Stored encrypted and never shown again. Leave it as it is to keep it.

server.intro: The 3x-ui panels services are created on. A new service goes to the panel with the fewest services for its weight, among the healthy panels its plan allows. Whatever you change here, existing services stay on their panel.
server.none: No servers yet. Add your 3x-ui panel to start selling.
server.name: Name
server.base_url_help: The panel's full address with its port and secret path, as you open it in a browser, for example https://panel.example.com:2053/path
server.token_help: Create it in the 3x-ui panel under Settings, API tokens. It is stored encrypted in the provisioner service and never shown again.
server.sub_url_help: Where customers' subscription links point, for example the panel's subscription domain. Empty uses the panel's own links. When it changes, existing links are updated within a few minutes.
server.weight_help: This panel's share of new services compared with the others: weight 200 takes twice as many as 100. From 1 to 1000.
server.enabled_help: When off, no new service is created here; its existing services keep working, renewing and syncing.
server.allow_private_help: Only for a panel on this server or your private network (for example 127.0.0.1 or a Docker network).
server.allow_private_warning: BOBRES will reach private addresses for this panel and may use plain http there, so the token travels unencrypted inside your network. Turn this on only for a panel on this machine or your own private network.
server.private_owner_only: Only the store owner can let BOBRES reach a panel on a private network.
server.private_owner_change: Only the store owner can change the address or token of a panel on a private network. Keep them as they are, or ask the owner.
server.address_changed: This server has {n} service. Change the address only when the same panel moved; pointing it to another panel leaves that service behind. | This server has {n} services. Change the address only when the same panel moved; pointing it to another panel leaves those services behind.
server.test_hint: Tries the address and token without saving.
server.test_failed: The panel could not be reached with these details.
server.version_untested: This panel version is outside the versions BOBRES is tested with; it may still work.
server.skip_check_help: Saving normally tests the connection first. Tick this when the panel is down for now, for example to turn the server off.
server.delete_confirm: Delete the server {name}? Only a server without services can be deleted; the panel itself is not touched.
server.in_use: A server with services cannot be deleted. Turn it off instead, so it takes no new services.
server.plans_any: Only plans open to any server
server.inbounds_note: Choose which inbounds new services on this panel join. This affects new services only: existing services keep the inbounds they have, and nothing changes in the panel itself.
server.no_inbound: No inbound is both on in the panel and chosen here, so new services on this server will fail.

invalid.url: A full address that starts with https://
invalid.https: Use https, or turn on “Panel on a private network” for a plain-http panel there.
invalid.https_owner: Use https. Only the store owner can add a plain-http panel on a private network.
invalid.credentials: Put the token in its own field, not a user name or password in the address.
invalid.sub_url: A full address that starts with https:// or http://

server.token_again: The panel's address moved to another host or port: enter the token again. A stored token is only sent to the address it was entered for.
server.version_range: BOBRES is tested with panel versions {min} to {max}; this version may still work.

gateway.intro: How customers pay. Zarinpal's merchant id and proxy, and the TronGrid key of automatic USDT, are stored encrypted in the payments service and never shown again. The manual methods and Telegram Stars show customers the details below.
gateway.key_missing_banner: The payments service has no encryption key yet, so Zarinpal's settings still come from the .env file and cannot be changed here. To add the key, run bobres install again on the server.
gateway.key_missing: Read only: add the payments key (run bobres install again) to change these here.
gateway.zarinpal_desc: Online card payments through your Zarinpal merchant account; payments are confirmed automatically.
gateway.enabled_help: Turning it off only stops offering it: payments already started are still checked and credited.
gateway.sandbox_help: Payments go to Zarinpal's test system and no real money moves. Never leave it on for customers.
gateway.sandbox_prod: Not available on a production install.
gateway.merchant_help: The 36-character id from your Zarinpal panel.
gateway.proxy_help: Zarinpal only answers calls from registered IP addresses. If this server's IP is not registered, send the calls through a proxy that is. The proxy must be http or https and may include a user name and password.
gateway.open_payments: {n} Zarinpal payment is still open. The merchant id and the sandbox cannot change until it finishes, or that payment could not be confirmed. | {n} Zarinpal payments are still open. The merchant id and the sandbox cannot change until they finish, or those payments could not be confirmed.

invalid.merchant: The merchant id has 36 characters: letters a to f and digits, in five groups separated by dashes.
invalid.proxy: A proxy address that starts with http:// or https://
invalid.needs_merchant: Enter the merchant id before turning Zarinpal on.

gateway.test_ok: Zarinpal answered: the merchant id and the route to it work.
gateway.test_unverified: {n} paid payment is waiting to be confirmed. | {n} paid payments are waiting to be confirmed.
gateway.test_failed: Zarinpal could not be reached or refused these details.

check_errors.title: Failed payment checks
check_errors.counts: {week} in the last 7 days, {month} in the last 30 days
check_errors.hint: Payments could not ask the gateway about these payments, or the gateway refused. Open payments are checked again by themselves; each payment is listed at most once an hour.

usdt.desc: Customers send an exact USDT amount on TRON (TRC20) to your address. The payment is found on the chain and confirmed automatically, with no transaction id to review. Toman prices are converted with the USDT rate of the Crypto (USDT) card, which stays available as the manual fallback.
usdt.enabled_help: Customers see the exact amount to send, your address and a deadline. Turning it off stops offering it.
usdt.address_help: The wallet that receives the USDT; customers see it. It cannot change while automatic payments are open.
usdt.api_key_help: Payments are found through TronGrid. Without a key it allows few requests; with many customers, add a free key from trongrid.io. Stored encrypted and never shown again.
usdt.proxy_help: Payments are found by calling TronGrid from this server. If TronGrid cannot be reached from here (it may be blocked in some countries), send the calls through a proxy that can reach it. The proxy must be http or https and may include a user name and password. Stored encrypted and never shown again.
usdt.open_payments: {n} automatic USDT payment is still open. The address cannot change until it finishes, or USDT sent to the old address would not be found. | {n} automatic USDT payments are still open. The address cannot change until they finish, or USDT sent to the old address would not be found.

invalid.address_format: A TRON address starts with T and has 34 letters and digits.
invalid.address_checksum: This address is not valid: one of its characters is wrong. Copy it again from your wallet.
invalid.address_required: Enter the address: it can be replaced, not removed.
invalid.needs_address: Enter the address before turning it on.
invalid.api_key: A TronGrid key has letters, digits and dashes, like xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx.

usdt.test_ok: TronGrid answered: this address can be watched.
usdt.test_failed: TronGrid could not be reached or refused the request.

problem.unreadable: The stored settings cannot be read (the payments key changed or is missing). Enter the address and the key again.
problem.invalid: These settings were refused, so automatic USDT is not offered. Check the address and the key.

usdt.unmatched_help: USDT that reached your address but matched no payment: a different amount, or too late. Nothing was credited for it. Find the customer, use Change balance on their page, then mark the deposit handled.
usdt.unmatched_more: The newest {shown} of {n} are listed. Mark them handled to see the rest.

reason.no_payment: No open payment has exactly this amount: underpaid, overpaid, or an exchange took its fee.
reason.already_paid: The payment with this amount was already paid: this is a second transfer.
reason.closed: The payment with this amount can no longer be paid (over 48 hours old, or failed).
reason.ambiguous: More than one payment has this amount, so none was chosen.
reason.dust: Under 0.1 USDT (dust). Such transfers are often sent to plant a look-alike address in your wallet history.

usdt.resolve_message: Do this only after you credited the customer by hand (Change balance on their page) or sent the USDT back. The deposit leaves this list and its transaction id is no longer accepted as a payment proof, so the same USDT is never credited twice. This cannot be undone.

manual_card.title: Card to card
manual_card.desc: Customers transfer to your card and send the receipt for you to review.

manual_crypto.title: Crypto (USDT)
manual_crypto.desc: Customers send USDT to your address and the transaction id for you to review.

manual_zarinpal.title: Zarinpal link
manual_zarinpal.desc: Customers pay on your own Zarinpal page and send the reference for you to review.

stars.title: Telegram Stars
stars.desc: Customers pay with Telegram Stars inside the bot; no key is needed.

problem.unreadable: The stored settings cannot be read (the payments key changed or is missing). Enter the merchant id again.
problem.sandbox_refused: The sandbox is refused on a production install: turn it off.

system.intro: How every BOBRES service is doing, whether a newer release is out, the backups, the HTTPS certificates and this install's license.
system.load_error: The system status could not be read.
system.not_installed: Not part of this install yet.
system.version_mismatch: Core runs version {version}, but these services run another one: {list}. Mixed versions can misbehave: restart them, or run bobres install again on the server, so all run the same release.
system.gateways_none: No payment method is turned on.
system.not_configured: Core has no address for this service in its settings.

alerts.title: Open problems
alerts.none: No open problems: every check passes.
alerts.unreadable: The open problems could not be read just now. Check again in a minute.
alerts.note: Core checks every minute: the services, the 3x-ui servers, Zarinpal, the backups and disk space, paid orders that could not be delivered, the bot's messages, the license and the HTTPS certificates. The bot tells the staff alert recipients on Telegram when a problem starts, once a day while it lasts, and when it is fixed.

updates.title: Version
updates.channel_hint: The channel is BOBRES_UPDATE_CHANNEL (stable or beta) in the server's .env file.
updates.beta_note: This install follows beta releases: newer pre-releases, less tested. Going back to stable does not downgrade: the install stays on its version until a stable release is newer.
updates.up_to_date: This install runs the latest release.
updates.newer_than_license: This release is newer than your license's update date. It is installed all the same: security updates are never withheld.
updates.how: To install it, run this on the server (as root):
updates.backup_first: It checks the release signature, backs up the database, installs the new version and rolls back on its own if the store does not come back healthy; sudo bobres rollback undoes the last update later. If bobres update stops with an error, the update and rollback runbook says what each message means and how to fix it.
updates.unverified: The bot did not check this release's signature. bobres update checks it before installing anything.
updates.last_check_failed: The last check for updates failed.

reason.unreachable: GitHub could not be reached from the server.
reason.bot_unreachable: The bot, which checks for updates, did not answer.
reason.not_checked: The bot has not checked yet. It checks when it starts, then every 12 hours.
reason.no_release: No BOBRES release has been published yet.
reason.bad_signature: The latest release did not pass the signature check (unsigned, altered, or signed with a revoked or expired key). Do not install it.
reason.invalid: The latest release's checksum file does not say which version it is.
reason.unsupported: This version of core does not report updates.

backups.started: The backup has started. This list updates when it is done.
backups.already_running: A backup is already being made.
backups.run_error: The backup could not be started.
backups.running: A backup is being made now. This list updates by itself.
backups.load_error: The backups could not be read.
backups.not_installed_title: The backup service is not installed.
backups.not_installed: To add it, re-run bobres install on the server (as root) and turn backups on:

backups.kept: The last 7 backups are kept on the server, encrypted; each is also sent to the owner on Telegram.

reason.too_big: Over Telegram's 50 MB limit, so it is kept on the server only.
reason.no_owner: The bot has no owner set, so it is kept on the server only.
reason.busy: The bot was busy sending another backup; it is kept on the server.
reason.blocked: The owner has blocked the bot, so it could not be sent; it is kept on the server.
reason.telegram_error: Telegram refused it; it is kept on the server.
reason.unreachable: The bot did not answer; it is kept on the server.
reason.other: Not sent to Telegram; it is kept on the server:

upload.failed: Not copied to off-site storage; it is kept on the server:

offsite.title: Off-site storage
offsite.broken: Set up, but its settings can't be used, so backups are not copied:
offsite.kept: Each new backup is also copied, still encrypted, to off-site storage, so a copy survives losing this server.
offsite.kept_n: Each new backup is also copied, still encrypted, to off-site storage, which keeps the newest {n}, so a copy survives losing this server.
offsite.how: Optional: to copy each backup to an S3-compatible storage (Arvan, MinIO, Backblaze B2, AWS), run {command} on the server; it then asks for the storage's two keys.
offsite.fix: To correct the setting named above, run {command} on the server. For the access or secret key, edit the {file} file on the server, then run {key_command}.
offsite.restore: To restore a copy from off-site storage, run {command} on the server (it downloads the file first), or download it from the storage yourself.

backups.restore: Restoring is done on the server, with the backup key the installer showed once (it is also in bobres menu, under Backup key). Each backup carries the services' own keys too, so a backup and the backup key are all you need. Keep the key safe, off the server.
backups.restore_later: To restore, run sudo bobres restore <file> on the server (see the restore runbook).

warn.ip_links: Dashboard links move to the IP address only once its certificate is proven and the bot detects this server's public address as that same IP address. Until then they stay on the domain. warn.ip_scan: The panel will answer anyone who connects to the IP address, not only visitors who use the domain.
warn.ip_ct: Let's Encrypt publishes the IP address in public Certificate Transparency logs.
warn.ip_ports: Let's Encrypt must reach ports 80 and 443 of this server from the internet. It does not work behind carrier-grade NAT (CGNAT) or a firewall that blocks them.
warn.ip_domain: Your domain keeps its own automatic certificate, so payment returns and Telegram webhooks keep working.
warn.manual_lockout: A wrong certificate can lock browsers out of the dashboard. If that happens, run {command} on the server to go back to the automatic certificate.
warn.manual_webhooks: Telegram webhooks, payment returns and some apps need a publicly trusted chain: add the intermediate certificates too.
warn.manual_renew: Caddy does not renew your own certificate. Upload a new one before it expires.
warn.auto_ports: Caddy needs ports 80 and 443 reachable from the internet, and the domain pointing at this server.

warning.expires_soon: The certificate ends soon. Caddy does not renew your own certificate: upload a new one before it expires.

activate.title: Activate with a license key
activate.hint: Enter the license key the seller gave you. The bot sends it, with this install's id and domain, to the license server; the license it answers is checked here and replaces the one in use now. Keep the key private: whoever has it can move the license to another install.
activate.key_hint: It starts with BOBRES-. This install sends it once and does not keep it.

problem.token: This is a license token, not a key: paste it in the token box below.
problem.long: This is too long to be a license key.
problem.format: This does not look like a license key (BOBRES- and groups of letters and digits).

activate.confirm_message: The license server's answer replaces the license in use now, and its limits apply to new actions at once. Moving a license to a new install or domain uses up one of its re-activations for the year.
activate.unreachable: The license server could not be reached, or it failed (the bot passes the request on). Try again later, or paste a license token from the seller below.
activate.not_configured: Online activation is not set up on this install (BOBRES_LICENSE_SERVER, read by the bot). Paste a license token from the seller below instead.

reason.invalid_key: No license has this key: check it for typos, or ask the seller.
reason.revoked: The seller has revoked this license.
reason.expired: This license has ended: renew it with the seller.
reason.reactivation_limit: This license has moved to another install as often as a year allows. The license server says when it may move again; or ask the seller.

license.no_keys: This build carries no vendor key (only a development build lacks one), so no license can be checked.
